t: The GP Ultra+ lithium coin batteries CR2032 features Wavy Net technology that improves power stability and enhances pulse discharge performance for longer-lasting energy. Advanced Customized Sealing Technology minimizes self-discharge and prevents leakage, achieving a shelf life of up to 10 years, when stored properly. Combined with distinctive electrolyte formulations, these batteries resist gas buildup and operate reliably in extreme temperatures from -20°C to +60°C, so devices work everywhere, every time. Safety is paramount, with child-resistant packaging designed to keep batteries out of reach of children
